verdict.rationale: Supermemory ships a documented, hosted MCP server (mcp.supermemory.ai) confirmed live via runtime probe, explicitly positioned to give 'every MCP-compatible assistant a shared memory layer' so Claude, ChatGPT, Cursor and others can share context via container tags/user profiles. This directly matches the story of a shared cross-tool memory layer, with OAuth-based auth confirmed working hands-on. missing for 10: no independent hands-on confirmation that Claude/ChatGPT/Cursor specifically were connected and successfully shared memory end-to-end, and no third-party review of cross-tool consistency beyond vendor docs.
